meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 当你报告 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时，Claude 会先查源码和运行记录，确定该 bug 所属的 GitHub 仓库，再生成带复现步骤、根因和修复建议的英文 issue 或 PR。
howto.when: 当你说要报告、提交或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件、上游 Codex CLI 等相关的 bug 时触发。

say.text: 帮我在 LazyCodex 仓库开一个 issue，反馈安装器报错的问题。
say.note: Claude 会调查源码并生成带证据的 bug 报告。

say.text: 这个 Codex CLI 的 bug 应该报给哪个仓库？
say.note: Claude 会对比源码和运行证据后给出路由判断。

say.text: 检查一下这个 bug 是不是上游 Codex 的问题，是的话建个 PR 修复。

howto.what_en: When you report a bug in LazyCodex, Codex plugins, or upstream Codex CLI, Claude first checks source code and runtime evidence, determines the owning GitHub repo, then creates an English issue or PR with reproduction steps, root cause, and fix guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, open, or triage bugs related to LazyCodex, Codex plugins, upstream Codex CLI, etc.

say_en.text: Open an issue in the LazyCodex repo about an installer error.
say_en.note: Claude investigates source and generates an evidence-backed bug report.

say_en.text: Which repo should this Codex CLI bug go to?
say_en.note: Claude compares source and runtime evidence to decide routing.

say_en.text: Check if this is an upstream Codex bug; if so, create a PR.
say_en.note: PRs are only created in openai/codex when the fix is concrete.
